$comment: Wave V2 of docs/COMPONENT-VARIANTS-PLAN.md: containers and navigation. Per component its style variants (id, name, what it is for, the pattern it follows, its source and licence) and its motion (enter, hover, press, change, reduced; the names are motion.json effects), and per pack the variants built. A component with no variant set shows its own look; variant adds bx-<kind>--<id> to its root. packs.react.mui lists the variants the React pack renders with @mui/material core (MIT); the react field marks a variant drawn with MUI where the component has a MUI counterpart.
